en: This is an image of a postage stamp, not a postcard. The stamp is brown and white with an illustration of a viaduct (bridge with arches) and a train passing over it. The stamp features stylized leaves on the sides and contains French text. The overprint indicates 'MOYEN CONGO' has been struck through and replaced with 'AFRIQUE ÉQUATORIALE FRANÇAISE'. The bottom of the stamp reads 'VIADUC DE MINDOULI'.
